sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Designed by architects Marcus Novais and Lucas Novais of Novais Arquitetura, this 203 m² (2,185 sq ft) apartment on Avenida Beira-Mar in Fortaleza, Ceará, was conceived to reflect the history and lifestyle of its residents: businessman and triathlete Cyro Thomaz, pastry chef Lia Quinderé, one of the couple's sons, and their dog Tobias.
